title: Evacuation Planning for Disaster Preparedness: An Adaptive Robust Optimization Approach
summary: Evacuation planning for disaster preparedness requires making critical decisions under uncertainty before the number and spatial distribution of evacuees are known, including shelter location, evacuation route assignment, and relief supply prepositioning. Because these decisions are highly interdependent, planners must balance the competing objectives of maximizing relief demand coverage and minimizing evacuation time.
